site_pack: runtime organisation profile; no benchmark-specific routing

persona.name: Meena
persona.behaviour: asks ordinary questions, prefers one decision at a time, wants maps and field material

turns.question: Tell me about the site.
Show me what local wildlife records are actually onboarded, grouped sensibly.
Give me a small dashboard of what we have learnt so far, with evidence types and gaps.
What snakes are at the site?
Can you model them?
Use the locally reported Russell's viper first. Tell me the next useful choice, not everything at once.
Help me understand where Indian star tortoise might occur at this site.
Yes, search a suitable wider region for occurrence records.
Use those records to test an environmental transfer and show me where field checks would give us the most information.
Make a field sheet for those points and say which local observations would improve the next model.
We want to raise native trees for restoration. What do our site assets already tell us about vegetation and planting?
Find admitted sources for two locally relevant tree species and inspect whether they contain germination or establishment measurements.
Turn usable source columns into a nursery and outplanting datasheet. Mark fields you added for our programme.
Show a dashboard structure for survival, growth and intervention, but do not invent outcomes we have not collected.
Lantana seems to return after clearing. What does local evidence actually report?
Can the current data show a rebound trend by season or year?
Map a practical monitoring design across the site and include paired cleared and uncleared checks if the data supports that design.
Summarise this investigation as a report with the map, method, gaps and next survey.
What can you measure about fire at the site from the assets and wired data?
Does that tell me the chance of fire next week?
Discover admitted weather, fuel or satellite datasets that could supply the missing predictors. Keep newly discovered datasets separate from wired layers.
Record the missing fire-risk model request and give me a dashboard of historical exposure, available predictors and gaps.
Has assisted natural regeneration worked better than planting here?
Use survival at 12 months as the outcome. Find a usable comparison protocol and tell me what baseline variables it needs.
Design matched monitoring plots on a map using admitted covariates. If optimisation is unavailable, show a balanced design and say so.
Prepare the datasheet and a dashboard shell for later outcomes.
Do birds spread Eucalyptus around this landscape?
Use only candidates named by returned evidence. Retrieve each candidate's occurrences and Eucalyptus records in the donor region.
Estimate the two distributions independently where gates pass, then map their overlap and field-check points.
What does that overlap establish, and what observation would test dispersal rather than simple colocation?
The survey did not see Russell's viper last September. Does that mean it is gone?
Design a repeated-detection survey for it. Search wider records if useful, then map strata and repeat visits.
Give the field team the point sheet and a short dashboard for effort, detections and habitat measurements.
What do we know about water, soil and vegetation condition at this site?
Can you show whether vegetation condition improved after restoration work?
Build a dashboard with any valid time series, intervention dates we actually have, uncertainty and missing measurements.
Find wider occurrence evidence for one locally reported reptile and retain the source identity.
Repeat the same retrieval now. If the intended source fails, do not change the ecological question or replace it with a different measurement.
Can we still make a map? Use cached observed points only if their identity and retrieval time are auditable; otherwise design new collection points.
